faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the KMRL Assistant Executive (Finance) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the KMRL Assistant Executive (Finance) recruitment is 27 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Executive (Finance) post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is CA/CMA(ICWAI) or MBA (Full time- Regular) or its equivalent with Finance as one of the specialization and with a minimum of 60% marks from a recognized University/Institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Executive (Finance) post is 30 years as of 01 August 2026. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Executive (Finance) position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Assistant Executive (Finance) position ranges from Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 1,20,000 per month, as per the IDA Scale.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Executive (Finance) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Assistant Executive (Finance) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the KMRL Assistant Executive (Finance) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test/Computer Based Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Regular.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. Can KMRL employees apply for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, KMRL employees are eligible for additional age relaxation: up to 5 years for regular employees and up to 3 years for contract employees with a 'Very Good' grading.
